verdict.rationale: Linear Agent features like 'Write with Agent' (drafts project updates from linked changes and Slack context) and automatic triage/labeling of customer feedback into prioritized issues show the product surfacing AI-generated suggestions from its own data, and 'Build agents that can investigate incidents, monitor SLAs, or analyze customer feedback' points toward data-driven insights. However, most agent documentation centers on coding/task execution (writing code, running tests, reviewing diffs) rather than broad analytical insights across issues/projects, and there is no independent/hands-on evidence validating the quality of these AI-generated insights. Missing for 10: dedicated analytics/insight dashboards, third-party validation of insight quality, and broader data-analysis use cases beyond feedback triage and update drafting.
